summary.name: CodeBuddy
summary.one_liner: CodeBuddy is Tencent Cloud's AI coding assistant and AI IDE, built on the Hunyuan code model, offering technical chat, code completion, diagnosis and optimization.
use_cases: Generate code and get help solving technical problems
Complete and optimize code inside an IDE
Import Figma images into an IDE chat session
Troubleshoot VS Code remote SSH and extension issues
summary.what_it_does: The page describes CodeBuddy as an AI IDE product that aims to support efficient, high-quality project delivery through intelligent productivity. It provides technical conversation, code completion, code diagnosis and optimization, based on Tencent's Hunyuan code large model. It supports creating new chat sessions and viewing chat history from the sidebar. The page is mainly a FAQ covering IDE troubleshooting: collecting local logs, remote SSH connection errors (glibc requirement from VS Code 1.99), Figma image import, marketplace compatibility settings, terminal shell integration, C/C++ extension installation, theme configuration, and a "buddy" terminal command for opening the IDE.
notable: Built on Tencent's Hunyuan code large model
Figma image import within the IDE (requires Figma permission and Tencent enterprise WeChat mail login)
Listed as Tencent Cloud MCP ecosystem programming partner (per listing)
Terminal command 'buddy' to open IDE window from the terminal
caveats: Figma import requires applying for Figma permission and logging in with Tencent enterprise WeChat mail
Remote development requires remote host with glibc>=2.28 (VS Code 1.99+)
Marketplace and C/C++ extension install issues may need workarounds
